summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K reporting daily share repurchases under its buy-back program announced 5 August 2026. On 13 August 2026, HSBC purchased 1,650,000 ordinary shares on UK venues at a volume-weighted average price of £15.3244 and 340,000 shares on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange at a volume-weighted average price of HK$162.3771. The shares were bought from BNP Paribas for cancellation. Aggregate buy-back consideration since commencement was US$137.6 million for 6,670,400 shares. No board recommendation or advisors were named. The transaction is a routine capital return through an on-market buy-back, with all shares cancelled and no treasury shares held. Watch for ongoing program execution updates and total voting rights adjustments after Hong Kong cancellations.
